title: CSV Consolidation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare CSV files and tubes
steps.instruction: Create up to four CSV files—one each for increase, no change, decrease, and inactive property changes—listing source wells from the 96‑well plate, one well per line (e.g., A2 A3 A4 A7 A8 B3 B5). To skip a pool, provide an empty CSV for that pool. Upload the CSVs to the robot. Seat the pooling tubes in an Opentrons 4×6 2 mL Eppendorf tube rack as follows: inactive → tube A1, decrease → tube B1, no change → tube C1, increase → tube D1.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the designated fields of the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file (.py) and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware definition files (.json).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script (.py) to the Opentrons app via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the tube rack and any other labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the Opentrons app; consult the support articles for calibration guidance.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons app to start the consolidation protocol.
